description: What is on Argentine streaming, radio and TV channels on a given day (today by default): each programme with its start and end time in Buenos Aires, the channel, the hosts and whether it is on air now, with the canonical url of each programme's page on prim.profblu.com. Filter by channel to get one channel's day, or ask only for what is on air now. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

date.description: Day in Buenos Aires, YYYY-MM-DD, from 7 days ago to 7 days ahead. Defaults to today.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

limit.description: How many programmes, 1 to 100. Defaults to 40.

onAirNow.description: true: only what is on air right now (ignores date).

name: get_schedule

suggestions.description: Only when what was asked for is not in Prim (or matches several): up to 3 similar names, to ask the user «did you mean…?». Nothing is claimed about them.

total.description: Programmes that day (after the channel filter)

title: Schedule of Argentine streaming channels
